# Vendored: dds.h

Used by `libprisma3d/src/prisma3d/core/Pixmap.cpp` to parse DDS headers (dimensions, format, mip offsets).

- `dds.h` — the single-header DDS utility by Turánszki János from Wicked Engine
  (https://github.com/turanszkij/WickedEngine), taken from the copy in
  prisma-samples `common/third_party/dds.h` on 2026-10-08. MIT license — see
  the block at the end of the file.

The file is not modified. Header only; nothing to compile.
